FEATURES: 📌 Base Model ($599 for 256GB) v. Upgraded Model ($699 for 512GB) 📌 Charging Adapter & USB-C cord included 📌 Memory & Storage: 8GB of unified memory with 256GB or 512GB storage options 📌 Ports: Two USB-C ports (one USB 3 and one USB 2) and a 3.5mm headphone jack 📌 Keyboard & Trackpad: Non-backlit, color-matched Magic Keyboard and a mechanical Multi-Touch trackpad 📌 Other Features: 1080p FaceTime HD camera, Bluetooth 6, and more! PERSONAL PROS: 👩🏾‍💻 Touch ID: The built-in keyboard feature (on the 512GB tier) makes unlocking my laptop quick! Loveee 👩🏾‍💻 Super lightweight, compact, easy to use for day-to-day browsing, etc. — Not to mention the 13-inch Liquid Retina display makes looking at the screen easy on the eyes 👩🏾‍💻 Battery Life: I've been able to go days without charging up, with no issues! PERSONAL CONS: 👩🏾‍💻 Wi-fi: For some odd reason, I did have a lot of issues getting my laptop to connect to wifi at home, and anywhere that I went — Thankfully a visit to the Apple store helped to resolve the issue, but I still don't know what the issue was to begin with 👩🏾‍💻 Not ideal for larger files/excessive tech workload Let me know if you have or have been thinking about the Neo, and your thoughts on the new release! 👀 #macbookneo #apple #applemacbook #unboxing #backtoshool
